    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_DecideExtension" name="Decide about extension"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Fetch" sourceRef="StartEvent_PlanLeave" targetRef="ServiceTask_FetchLeaveModels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fetch_Merge" sourceRef="ServiceTask_FetchLeaveModels" targetRef="Gateway_Extension_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Select" sourceRef="Gateway_Extension_Merge" targetRef="UserTask_SelectLeaveModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Collect" sourceRef="UserTask_SelectLeaveModel" targetRef="UserTask_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_NotifySS" sourceRef="UserTask_CollectInformation" targetRef="SendTask_NotifySocialSecurity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifySS_NotifyCompany" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="SendTask_NotifyCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyCompany_Gather" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyCompany" targetRef="UserTask_GatherCompanyInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gather_LeaveEnds" sourceRef="UserTask_GatherCompanyInformation" targetRef="IntermediateEvent_LeavePeriodEnds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LeaveEnds_Decide" sourceRef="IntermediateEvent_LeavePeriodEnds" targetRef="UserTask_DecideExtension"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decide_Gateway" sourceRef="UserTask_DecideExtension" targetRef="Gateway_Extension_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Extend_Merge" name="Yes, extend" sourceRef="Gateway_Extension_Decision" targetRef="Gateway_Extension_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoExtend_End" name="No, do not extend" sourceRef="Gateway_Extension_Decision" targetRef="EndEvent_LeaveCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
